meaning: numerical/standing gate; new-scene local survival and loading are diagnostic, not acceptance

nominal_payload.assistance_definition: No upward assistance/fixtures; downward payload is explicitly reported separately
nominal_payload.heldout_scope: independent seeded draws within current-stage training support; not an OOD gate
nominal_payload.label: smoke_local_0p4kg

payload_measurements.scope: external downward gravity-equivalent payload only; no physical crate/inertia/contact/offset torque

nominal_payload.payload_model: world downward force at each wrist-body CoM; no crate inertia/contact/moment model
nominal_payload.payload_neighborhood_ramp: CLOSE_SEAT shared rigid smoothstep; fixed for probe/higher/hold
nominal_payload.payload_phase_exposure_definition: phase had measured peak >=90% of requested weight; NOT a loaded precision or grasp success
nominal_payload.reference_batching: one prevalidated desired-goal batch per phase; no physical step skipping
nominal_payload.scene_offset_scope: fixed once per case; both wrists and all phases share one scene transform
nominal_payload.scope: actor-driven high-wrist Reach with phase-gated equivalent gravity payload; NOT real crate grasping
